legend: Carlinhos loves movies, and recently he has been fascinated by the Bacon Number, which is defined as follows.
The Bacon number of the actor Kevin Bacon is equal to 0$$$0$$$;
If the smallest Bacon number of an actor with whom X has appeared in the same movie is b$$$b$$$, the bacon number of the actor X is b+1$$$b+1$$$.
That is, the Bacon number measures the shortest path between any actor and the actor Kevin Bacon, in which two actors are connected if they appeared together in the same movie.

Carlinhos is interested in a more general problem: given two actors, how to connect them through intermediate movies and actors? Given N$$$N$$$ movies, and, for each movie, which of the existing M$$$M$$$ actors acted in it. Carlinhos wants to answer Q$$$Q$$$ queries: in the i$$$i$$$-th of them, we want to compute some way to connect actor xi$$$x_i$$$ with actor yi$$$y_i$$$. We must find some sequence xi=a1,f1,a2,f2,…,fk−1,ak=yi$$$x_i = a_1, f_1, a_2, f_2, \dots, f_{k-1}, a_k = y_i$$$, where 1≤aj≤M$$$1 \leq a_j \leq M$$$ are actors and 1≤fj≤N$$$1 \leq f_j \leq N$$$ are movies, and actor aj$$$a_j$$$ acted in movies fj−1$$$f_{j-1}$$$ and fj$$$f_j$$$, or indicate that no such sequence exists.
input: In the first line of the input, two integers N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤100)$$$(1 \leq N \leq 100)$$$ and M$$$M$$$ (1≤M≤106)$$$(1 \leq M \leq 10^6)$$$ are given, the number of movies and the number of actors.

N$$$N$$$ lines follow. In the i$$$i$$$-th line, the first integer ni$$$n_i$$$ (1≤ni≤M)$$$(1 \leq n_i \leq M)$$$ denotes the number of actors in movie i$$$i$$$. Next, ni$$$n_i$$$ numbers in ascending order separated by spaces: the indices, from 1$$$1$$$ to M$$$M$$$, of the actors who acted in movie i$$$i$$$.
The next line, contains an integer Q$$$Q$$$ (1≤Q≤104)$$$(1 \leq Q \leq 10^4)$$$: the number of queries.

The next Q$$$Q$$$ lines describe the queries. In the i$$$i$$$-th of them, read two numbers xi,yi$$$x_i, y_i$$$ (1≤xi≠yi≤M)$$$(1 \leq x_i \neq y_i \leq M)$$$, the actors we want to connect. It is guaranteed that the total number of actors in the movies is at most 106$$$10^6$$$. That is, ∑ini≤106$$$\sum_i n_i \leq 10^6$$$.
output: For each of the queries, if there is no sequence, print a line with −1$$$-1$$$. Otherwise, print two lines. In the first line, print the number of actors ki$$$k_i$$$ (2≤ki≤106)$$$(2 \leq k_i \leq 10^6)$$$ in some way to connect xi$$$x_i$$$ and yi$$$y_i$$$. In the second, print the sequence as described, with ki$$$k_i$$$ actors and ki−1$$$k_i - 1$$$ movies, alternating. If there is more than one way to connect the actors, print any of them.

legend.ai: Carlinhos 喜欢电影，最近他对 Bacon 数很着迷，其定义如下。
演员 Kevin Bacon 的 Bacon 数等于 0$$$0$$$；
如果与 X 出演过同一部电影的演员中，Bacon 数的最小值为 b$$$b$$$，则演员 X 的 Bacon 数为 b+1$$$b+1$$$。
也就是说，贝肯数表示任意演员与演员 Kevin Bacon 之间的最短路径；如果两名演员出演过同一部电影，则认为他们相连。

Carlinhos 对一个更一般的问题感兴趣：给定两名演员，如何通过中间的电影和演员将他们连接起来？给定 N$$$N$$$ 部电影，以及对于每部电影，给出 M$$$M$$$ 名现有演员中出演该电影的那些演员。Carlinhos 希望回答 Q$$$Q$$$ 个查询：在第 i$$$i$$$ 个查询中，我们希望计算出一种将演员 xi$$$x_i$$$ 与演员 yi$$$y_i$$$ 连接起来的方法。我们必须找到某个序列 xi=a1,f1,a2,f2,…,fk−1,ak=yi$$$x_i = a_1, f_1, a_2, f_2, \dots, f_{k-1}, a_k = y_i$$$，其中 1≤aj≤M$$$1 \leq a_j \leq M$$$ 的是演员，1≤fj≤N$$$1 \leq f_j \leq N$$$ 的是电影，并且演员 aj$$$a_j$$$ 出演了电影 fj−1$$$f_{j-1}$$$ 和 fj$$$f_j$$$；或者指出不存在这样的序列。

input.ai: 输入的第一行给出两个整数 N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤100)$$$(1 \leq N \leq 100)$$$ 和 M$$$M$$$ (1≤M≤106)$$$(1 \leq M \leq 10^6)$$$，分别表示电影数和演员数。
接下来有 N$$$N$$$ 行。第 i$$$i$$$ 行中，第一个整数 ni$$$n_i$$$ (1≤ni≤M)$$$(1 \leq n_i \leq M)$$$ 表示电影 i$$$i$$$ 中的演员数。接下来是按升序排列、以空格分隔的 ni$$$n_i$$$ 个数：出演电影 i$$$i$$$ 的演员编号，编号范围从 1$$$1$$$ 到 M$$$M$$$。
下一行包含一个整数 Q$$$Q$$$ (1≤Q≤104)$$$(1 \leq Q \leq 10^4)$$$，表示查询数量。
接下来的 Q$$$Q$$$ 行描述查询。在第 i$$$i$$$ 个查询中，读入两个数 xi,yi$$$x_i, y_i$$$ (1≤xi≠yi≤M)$$$(1 \leq x_i \neq y_i \leq M)$$$，表示我们要连接的演员。保证所有电影中的演员总数至多为 106$$$10^6$$$。也就是说，∑ini≤106$$$\sum_i n_i \leq 10^6$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个查询，如果不存在这样的序列，输出一行 −1$$$-1$$$。否则，输出两行。第一行输出用于连接 xi$$$x_i$$$ 和 yi$$$y_i$$$ 的演员数量 ki$$$k_i$$$ (2≤ki≤106)$$$(2 \leq k_i \leq 10^6)$$$。第二行按照上述描述输出该序列，其中演员和电影交替出现，共有 ki$$$k_i$$$ 名演员和 ki−1$$$k_i - 1$$$ 部电影。如果连接这些演员的方式不止一种，输出任意一种即可。
